title: Great Alhambra Guide
text: We visited the Alhambra with Noelia. We selected the Spanish tour. She was the best guide we could have, approachable and very friendly. She also explained everything perfectly to us. Management of time was perfect. 100% recommended this company.
author: travelwithmili

title: Don't doubt it even a little, it is 100% worth it.
text: Incredible! The guide was wonderful. The tour was perfectly organized and complete. Thank you and I highly recommend it!!!
author: claudiadI5427FB

title: Visit to the Alhambra
text: I loved the guided tour; the guide, whose name was Vicky, made the visit very enjoyable for us and explained everything in great detail. I recommend it 100%.
author: M8907AZsoniag

title: Impressive
text:
I highly recommend it.
The experience was incredible, they have everything very well planned, and the guide was incredible.
author: U3639YXluciad

title: Professionalism and complete satisfaction
text: The truth is that at the end of the tour the feeling was that we had been very lucky. Vicki was spectacular, the visit was pleasant, friendly, and very professional; you could tell by the number of Alhambra staff who greeted her. If you can choose a guide, it is a winning bet. Congratulations to turismoyocio. A 10. Thank you for making our visit a success.
author: teodoroa301

title: Sensational visit
text: Our guide Laura was excellent; I don't usually write on these pages, but today a person who arrived late to the tour treated the guide in a very rude manner, something that the rest of the group did not like, so I want to congratulate Laura for her poise and politeness at all times.
author: sergiosG4351XB

title: Exceptional guide
text:
Excellent guided tour with Marian, a fantastic guide, very engaging, with a lot of knowledge that she knows how to convey in a simple and easy-to-understand way. Time flew by.
We enjoyed it a lot
Great
author: eduardomU8610ZT

title: Essential.
text:
Fantastic!
You cannot visit the Alhambra without entering the palaces!
If I had to point out a downside, being a guided tour, you cannot enjoy the experience as much as I would like during the tour! We will leave that for a second visit! But the explanation was very good!
author: 517rub_nf

title: Excellent guided visit
text: Excellent guide to Enrique. He knows a lot about history , besides being very polite and attentive . The visit was sensational
author: ClaudiaR3049

title: Great visit to the Alhambra with our guide Mari Angeles
text: We loved the visit, the alhambra is impressive and our guide, Mari Angeles, super friendly and very knowledgeable. Made our tour super enjoyable and interesting, with lots of data and very well explained, answered all our questions kindly. We will certainly repeat in the future.
author: ivanbP3611BL
